description: This file defines a list of masks with associated contexts, configurations, and metadata for a chat application, specifically for the 'tw' (Taiwanese) language. It includes various predefined masks such as image search, copywriting, machine learning, logistics, career advising, translation, language detection, content creation, resume writing, psychological counseling, startup ideas, internet writing, and philosophical guidance.

classes.name: BuiltinMask
classes.description: Type or interface representing the structure of a mask object, including avatar, name, context, model configuration, language, and metadata.

methods.name: TW_MASKS
methods.description: A constant array exporting multiple predefined mask objects for different roles and functionalities within the chat application.
